title: Write the dispatch schedule and the gear order
purpose: Every new site gets its phones, people, and gear on a named day, from inventory that really exists.
with: Moharam for the start date and the daily target, and the Portfolio Manager for the site visit
when: After the site visit, and again whenever phones or people come free.
needs: The notes from the site visit
The dashboard with last night's numbers

steps.do: Read the visit notes and write the site plan
steps.detail: Phones, one operator per ten phones, a 10% bench, 10% spares, the upload path, and the shift pattern.
steps.check: One number for phones, people, and spares.

steps.time: The morning after the evening check-out
steps.detail: How many floors are active, when each project ends, and which phones and people come free.
steps.check: You know what is free and when.

steps.detail: Phones, operators, reviewers, hubs, and internet speed for the hours the site will record.
steps.check: Nothing is short. If it is, the date waits.

steps.do: Pick the phones by device number and the people by name
steps.detail: From inventory that exists today, never from another site's kit.
steps.check: Every phone and every person is named.

steps.do: Set the upload path and the start date with Moharam
steps.detail: The site's own wireless internet, if it passed the test, or the closest hub. Moharam agrees the daily hour target.
steps.check: Moharam said yes to the date and the target.

steps.do: Write the dispatch schedule and the gear order
steps.detail: Which phones leave the store on which day, who goes where, and what the store has to fill.
steps.check: Every line has a day and a name.

steps.detail: Moharam, the Commercial Director, and the Portfolio Manager get the schedule. The gear order starts the gear procedure.
steps.check: The Portfolio Manager confirmed the handover day.

steps.do: Put the site on the dashboard and keep the schedule true
steps.detail: The site with its target and start date. When something moves, rewrite the lines that changed and resend them.
steps.check: The dashboard and the schedule say the same thing.

done: Moharam agreed the date and target. The gear order is written. Everyone has the schedule. The site is on the dashboard.

fails.then: The date waits. Order the gear the same day. Mano opens hiring. Tell Moharam the same day.

fails.if: The dashboard disagrees with the floor
fails.then: Do not write a schedule on a number you do not trust. The Portfolio Manager checks the floor and the site sends the evening check-out again.

fails.if: The store cannot fill the order by the day
fails.then: Launch day moves. No site launches short.

fails.if: The closest hub has no room
fails.then: Send the runs to the backup upload place. Two nights over 70% goes to Adham with the hub decision.

fails.if: Phones or people move after the schedule went out
fails.then: Rewrite the lines that changed that night and resend them.

escalate: Moharam the same day for the date or the people. Mano the same day when people must be hired.
